Khoảnh khách tuyệt vời nhất trong đời chính là...
My eyes find love in you.
Knowing I will spend forever by your side,
By your side, with you by mine.
From now on, a new day to celebrate, and a life shared with you.
All the joy of my remaining years belongs to you.
Fills my life with endless wonder.
